summary.text: Ferrell Haile is a Republican state senator from Gallatin representing Tennessee Senate District 18 (Sumner and Trousdale Counties), a member of the 107th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Senate Ethics Committee and serves as Speaker Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: Haile attended Lipscomb University and earned a pharmacy degree from the University of Tennessee Pharmacy School.
He is a former owner of Perkins Drugs in Gallatin and owns Haile Farms in Gallatin.
He is married to Kay; they have four children and eight grandchildren.
In the Senate he is also vice-chair of the Health and Welfare Committee, treasurer of the Senate Republican Caucus, and a member of the Education, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Rules committees.

His page lists past service on the Sumner County Health Department board, the Gallatin Rotary Clubs and the Christian Towers board, and awards including the 2019 Shelby Rhinehart Public Service Lifetime Achievement Award from the Tennessee Pharmacists Association.
